settings.title: Assistant
settings.intro: Configure the assistant that turns natural language into Pandora commands.
settings.testDesc: Runs a round-trip call to confirm the key and model.

settings.providerDesc: The language model that interprets your sentences.
settings.noKeyAction: Add the Gemini key under Connections
settings.modelDesc: The provider's model. You can change it anytime; the reachability test confirms it.
settings.confirmationDesc: How readily the assistant acts without asking first.
settings.localeDesc: The language the assistant replies in. The default follows your account language.
settings.enabledDesc: When off, the assistant ignores your messages.

kind.no_key: No API key configured for this provider.
kind.rejected: The provider rejected the call (invalid key or model).

settings.accountDesc: Which of your keys the assistant uses.

bar.title: Assistant
bar.intro: Ask in plain language to create reminders, tasks and notes, or to look up your agenda and finances.
bar.micDenied: Couldn't use the microphone. Check the browser's permission.
bar.notEnabled: Turn the assistant on in settings to use it.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.subtitle: Preferences that apply across Pandora: appearance, language and the time zone used by the modules.

palette.label: Theme
palette.desc: The colors of the whole app, in the mode above. Saved to your account.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.desc: Main buttons, links and what is selected. Success, error and warning colors do not change.

settings.desktopAutostartDesc: Opens Pandora in the tray when you sign in to Windows. Applies to this computer only.
settings.themeDesc: Choose light, dark or follow the system. The preference is saved to your account.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language. The preference is saved to your account.
settings.timeZoneDesc: Your reference clock, for every module: the Agenda's schedule, the Finances' dates, the notifications' quiet hours.
settings.weekStartsOnDesc: The first day of the week in the calendar.
settings.alertOffsetDesc: How far ahead new events and tasks alert you by default.

notifications.pageSubtitle: Where you get notified, what goes out on each channel, and when to stay quiet.
notifications.disabledReason: This channel was disabled: {{reason}}. Reconnect to receive again.
notifications.telegramDesc: Connect Telegram to receive alerts and reply with inline buttons.
notifications.linkInstructions: Open Telegram and tap Start to finish linking. The link is valid for a few minutes.
notifications.testError: Could not send the test message.
notifications.emailFromAccount: Your account e-mail is used automatically.
notifications.preferencesDesc: Choose the channels each kind of alert goes out on.
notifications.mutedHint: Unchecking every channel mutes that category. A channel only delivers once connected.
notifications.historyDesc: What went out, by channel, and how it ended.
notifications.quietHoursDesc: A daily do-not-disturb window. Notifications that land inside it are held back — except security alerts, which always go out.
notifications.quietHoursZoneHint: Times are in your own time zone.
notifications.quietHoursInvalid: Set a start and end time — they cannot be the same.

connections.title: Connected accounts
connections.description: Connect the third-party accounts Pandora uses on your behalf. You can connect several per provider; each feature picks the one it uses.
connections.reconnectNeeded: This connection was revoked. Reconnect it to continue.
connections.noneAvailable: No provider is configured on this server.

apiKey.saveError: Could not save the API key.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.description: A log of connects, refresh failures and revocations — the answer to why a sync stopped.

connections.otherAccount: You signed in with a different account, so it was added as a new one. The account you were reconnecting was left as it was.

select.dangling: The selected account was disconnected. Pick another one.

devices.title: Connected devices
devices.subtitle: Computers and apps that reach your Pandora with their own key instead of your session. Each key is limited to what the device needs and stops working the moment you revoke it.
devices.notPairedDesc: Connect this computer so desktop features can work in the background, even with the window closed.
devices.pairedDesc: This computer has its own key, kept encrypted for your Windows user.
devices.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Its key stops working right away.

security.title: Two-factor authentication (MFA)
security.lowCodes: Few recovery codes left. Consider regenerating them.
security.startDesc: You'll need an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.).
security.scanDesc: Scan the QR Code in your authenticator, or enter the key manually, then provide the generated code.
security.recoveryTitle: Keep these codes in a safe place
security.recoveryDesc: Each code can be used once to sign in if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.

home.welcome: Welcome to Pandora. Use the sidebar to navigate and your user menu, in the top right corner, to manage your account and security.

finances.comingSoonDesc: This area of the finances module is still under construction.

accounts.name: Name

transactions.amountInHint: Fill in only for transfers between different currencies.

recurring.name: Name
recurring.intervalHint: How many periods between occurrences (e.g. every 2 months).
recurring.startDateHint: Sets the first occurrence and the anchor day (e.g. day of month).
recurring.maxOccurrencesHint: Finishes the recurrence after generating this many occurrences.
recurring.autoPostHint: When on, each account occurrence is posted directly, skipping the inbox.
recurring.cardAlwaysInbox: Card recurrences always go through the inbox for review.
recurring.autoGenerateHint: When off, the system won't generate occurrences automatically; you generate them manually whenever you want.
recurring.advanceScheduleHint: When on, consumes the occurrence and advances the next date. Turn off to generate several records without affecting the recurrence.

inbox.transferInvalid: Select one outflow and one inflow suggestion, both on accounts.
inbox.transferDone: Transfer created from the two suggestions.

categories.systemDesc: Default system categories used as reference. Read-only.
categories.name: Name

cards.name: Name
cards.accountTooltip: The account this card belongs to. Its bank routes card-bill imports to the right layout.

statements.title: Statements
statements.settleConfirm: Marks the statement as paid without debiting any account. Use for pre-Pandora statements. Records a write-off for the remaining amount.

audit.filterHint: Audit is queried by entity (type + ID) or by correlation ID.
audit.emptyFilter: Provide an entity type and ID, or a correlation ID, to view events.

tags.name: Name
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete this tag? Its links will be removed.

imports.uploaded: File uploaded and queued for processing.
imports.selectDestinationFirst: Select an account or card before uploading.
imports.cutoffHint: Optional: entries dated before this are ignored on import (no suggestion created). Leave empty to import everything.
imports.linked: Suggestion linked to the existing transaction.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.empty: No attachments yet. Images and PDFs, up to 25 MB each.
attachments.queueHint: Files you shared with the Telegram bot. File one under a transaction here, or under a suggestion or a statement from its own 📎.

history.title: Version history
history.description: Every save with changes is kept indefinitely. Expand edit groups to access each version.
history.restoreDescription: The selected state will be restored as a new version. Current history will be preserved. Review the differences before confirming.
history.legend: + Added · − Removed · Body compared as Markdown
history.diffTooLarge: The comparison exceeded its time limit. View each version in preview instead.

graphVisibility.empty: No notes match the graph visibility filters.

tableSize.title: Insert table

notes.viewSplit: Markdown and reading side by side

visual.placeholder: Write, or type / to pick a block

library.searchEmpty: Nothing in the library has that name.

reminders.subtitle: What should get your attention, and when. Snoozing moves it to later.

gate.title: Files is off
gate.desc: Turn Files on to catalog your disks and find anything on them from any device.

settings.title: Files settings
settings.intro: Files catalogs what is on your disks — names, sizes, dates — so you can find it from anywhere. The files themselves never leave the device.
settings.enabledDesc: Off hides Files everywhere and the devices stop scanning.
settings.deviceDesc: Turn on in the computer that has the disks. The app restarts to apply it.
settings.notPaired: This computer is not connected to your account, so it cannot scan.

roots.title: Devices and roots
roots.intro: A root is a disk or folder a device catalogs. Choose its folders, schedule and options; each device scans only its own roots.
roots.agentOff: This computer does not scan disks.
roots.agentOffAction: Turn it on in Files settings
roots.agentError: The last contact with Pandora failed
roots.empty: No roots yet. Add the first disk or folder to catalog.
roots.deviceEmpty: No roots on this computer yet.
roots.localPathTyped: The path as the device writes it (E:\, /mnt/hd). It is checked on the first scan.
roots.name: Name
roots.scheduleDesc: The first scan is always started with “Scan now”, after you choose the folders.
roots.caseSensitive: Upper and lower case in names
roots.removeDesc: Scanning stops, and its entries go to the review inbox.

scan.counts: Last scan {{when}}: {{seen}} seen, {{created}} new, {{changed}} changed, {{moved}} moved, {{missing}} missing, {{excluded}} excluded
scan.held: The last scan would mark {{missing}} of {{seen}} entries missing
scan.heldDesc: That is a lot — maybe a disk came up empty or under another letter. Apply it only if the files are really gone.

reason.root-unavailable: the disk or folder was not found on the device
reason.entries-seen-mismatch: part of the scan was lost on the way

selection.title: Folders of {{name}}
selection.introLive: Check what this computer catalogs. Unchecking a folder leaves out everything inside it, unless you check a folder below it again.
selection.introCatalog: This tree shows the folders the catalog already knows. To mark a folder it has not seen, type its path below.
selection.noMarks: No marks: the whole root is cataloged.
selection.nextScan: Changes apply on the next scan.

filters.title: Filters
filters.intro: Name rules on top of the chosen folders. An exclude filter always wins; with an include filter in scope, only the files it matches are kept.
filters.name: Name
filters.patternHint: Extensions separated by commas (mkv, mp4); a glob like *.part; or a regex.
filters.scopePathDesc: A folder of the root, like /Movies. Empty is the whole root.
filters.folderOnlyExcludes: Folder filters only exclude, and skip the folder's contents entirely.

actionDesc.include: Only files that match an include filter are kept.

filters.previewCount: Matches {{count}} entries in the catalog now

catalog.title: Files
catalog.intro: Browse a root folder by folder, or search every root by fragments of a name, title or artist.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, title or artist — e.g. breaking bad s02
catalog.name: Name

review.title: Review
review.intro: Entries the last scans did not find (missing) or that the folders and filters now leave out (excluded). Forget removes them from the catalog; Keep leaves them in it, out of this list.
review.forgetDesc: They leave the catalog. The files on disk are not touched.

mail.noSelection: Select a message to read it.
mail.imagesBlocked: Remote images are hidden, so the sender does not learn you opened this message.

actions.trashConfirm_one: Move this message to the trash?
actions.label: Labels
actions.error: The mail server did not accept this. Nothing was changed.

compose.subject: Subject
compose.markdownHint: Plain text works. Markdown is formatted when it goes out.
compose.sentNoCopy: Message sent, but no copy could be saved in Sent.
compose.emptyTitle: Send with no subject or text?

labels.name: Name
labels.deleteHint: On Gmail the messages only lose the label. On other providers only an empty folder can be deleted.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: What happens to new mail. On Gmail a rule is a filter of your Gmail account; elsewhere it runs in Pandora, while Pandora is running.
rules.none: No rules in this mailbox yet.
rules.readOnlyHint: This filter does more than a rule can hold. Edit it in Gmail.
rules.rawFilter: The filter as Gmail sent it
rules.filterSyncError: Could not read this mailbox's Gmail filters. The rules below may be out of date.
rules.deleteFilterDesc: This deletes the filter from your Gmail account too, for good. Nothing here can bring it back.
rules.deleteReadOnlyDesc: This deletes the filter from your Gmail account too, for good, including what a rule cannot show, such as a forward. Nothing here can bring it back.
rules.disableDesc: Gmail has no disabled filters, so this deletes the filter from Gmail and it stops working there too. Enabling the rule makes it again.
rules.consentTitle: Gmail needs your permission to change filters
rules.consentDesc: Your rule stays as it is while you grant access.

error.name: Give the rule a name of at most 100 characters.
error.noLabel: Choose a label for every action that needs one.
error.gmailOneOfEach: On Gmail, a rule takes one condition of each kind. "Has the words" and "Gmail search" count as one.
error.gmailOneLabel: On Gmail, a rule takes one label.

accounts.title: Email accounts
accounts.description: Mailboxes Pandora keeps a copy of. Only headers are stored; a message's body is fetched when you open it.
accounts.connected: {{address}} connected. The first messages arrive in a moment.
accounts.titanHint: The address and password you use in Titan webmail.
accounts.reconnectTitle: Sync stopped: the server refused the credentials.
accounts.errorTitle: The last sync failed; it is retried on the next cycle.
accounts.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current one.
accounts.deleteDesc: Pandora's copy of the messages is deleted; nothing changes on the server. The account stays in Connections.
